title: 'We beat ourselves.' Chargers struggle across the board in preseason loss to 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'We beat ourselves.' Chargers struggle across the board in preseason loss to 49ers
sources.description: Jake Slaughter starts at center for the Chargers and Trey Lance shows his speed, but miscues on special teams and defense lead to a preseason loss to the 49ers.
